in_arabic.name: سُوَيبَة
in_arabic.meaning: معنى اسم سوِيبَة: جميلة، رقيقة، مكسوة بالثياب
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم سوِيبَة من أصل عربي، ويُطلق على الأنثى، ويُفسر بأنّه مِثل "البَتّانة" أو "اللّبّة" في الدين الإسلامي، أو "المِسّحة" التي يُستخدمها المسلمون في الصلاة. يُعتقد أنّ الاسم يحمل معاني الجمال، الرّقة، والعناية بالشخصية. لا يوجد أي إشارة مُباشرة إلى اسم سوِيبَة في القرآن الكريم أو السنة النبوية، لكنه يُستخدم بشكل شائع في الثقافة الإسلامية.

data.cultural_impact: The name Suwaibah holds a rich cultural significance in the Islamic tradition, as it is the name of a renowned female companion of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). Suwaibah bint As-Suhayl was a young, pious woman who migrated from Mecca to Medina with her father and brothers. She was known for her outstanding character and dedication to her faith. Suwaibah's story serves as an inspiration to Muslims around the world, demonstrating the power of faith, courage, and resilience in the face of adversity.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Suwaibah carries deep spiritual significance, as it represents attributes that are highly valued in Islam. Suwaibah's name reminds us of the importance of being gentle and delicate in our actions and interactions with others. It also signifies the resilience and strength that comes from having faith in Allah, even during difficult times. Ultimately, the name Suwaibah serves as a reminder to be fragrant in our character and actions, embodying the essence of compassion, grace, and resilience that is encouraged in our faith.
